name: Newmarket B / Yonge Street
description: The former Newmarket–Aurora–Richmond Hill–North York bus along Yonge Street. Older timetables call this Table 62 and Newmarket B; the final contemporary notice explicitly calls it route 62.

timeline.event: The Newmarket B corridor was among the early GO bus services; this does not establish that number 62 was publicly used in 1970.
Table 62 documents Newmarket Bus Terminal to York Mills, with some trips entering the north lot at Langstaff GO.
The documented Yonge Street service still ran to York Mills, via the Finch and Sheppard areas.
Last operating day of route 62. Viva Blue A began June 28 as its replacement between Newmarket and Finch.

gaps: The 2004 table refers to Table 63 for Newmarket B express service. That reference is not evidence that the later King City route 63 was the former Yonge C route.
